concerns.text: SSoT writer inconsistency: plan.md Phase 2 states compute_metrics.py 'Write the SSoT data/processed/processed_prs.csv', but quickstart.md Step 1 runs classify_provenance.py with '--output data/processed/processed_prs.csv' (the SSoT path) and Step 2 runs compute_metrics.py with '--output data/processed/filtered_prs.csv'. One of the two documents misstates which script produces the FR-020 SSoT.

concerns.location: plan.md: Project Structure vs quickstart.md Step 2
concerns.text: quickstart.md references 'data/processed/filtered_prs.csv' as the input to statistical_analysis.py, but the plan's Project Structure tree lists only 'processed_prs.csv' under data/processed/ and Phase 3 (outlier_filter.py) does not name its output file. Add the filtered/variant filenames to the structure so the derivation chain (Constitution III/IV) is fully specified.
